clips.title: The story
paras: After the Third War, Grommash Hellscream's people are free of the Blood Curse. Once bound to the Burning Legion by his thirst for battle, the Warsong chieftain gave his life to slay Mannoroth in Ashenvale and free the orcs.

Before the Dark Portal opened, Grom Hellscream led the Warsong clan with fierce resolve. His pitch-black tattooed jaw and the deadly sweep of his two-handed axe, Gorehowl, set him apart. On Draenor, Gul'dan and the Shadow Council offered the orcs demonic strength. Grom was the first chieftain to drink the blood of the pit lord Mannoroth. The draught bound the orcs to demonic service and filled them with burning bloodlust. Many chieftains perished or lost themselves to it, but Grom kept his fierce spirit through the old Horde's horrors. He carried a quiet ache for what his people had surrendered.

Left behind on Draenor during the Second War, Grom later crossed the Dark Portal and was stranded when the rift was shattered. For nearly fifteen years, he and the surviving Warsong warriors evaded the Alliance of Lordaeron. They endured the lethargy and despair that followed the fading of the demon blood. Then a young fugitive named Thrall found Grom in the wilderness, and hope returned. Grom saw Thrall's strength and noble heart, and taught him the proud heritage of their people. Together with Orgrim Doomhammer, they rallied the scattered clans, broke open the human internment camps, and began the New Horde.

During the Third War, Grom's aggression rose again in Ashenvale's ancient forests. The night elves and the demigod Cenarius pressed his clan hard, and Grom drank from a fountain corrupted with Mannoroth's blood to save them. Bound again to the demon lord, he turned against his own people. Thrall and Jaina Proudmoore captured him and cleansed his spirit with ancient shamanic and arcane rites. Restored to his senses and burdened with guilt, Grom pursued Mannoroth into Demon Fall Canyon. He drove Gorehowl into the demon lord's chest, ending the demonic curse forever. Hellfire took Grom's life.
